Hi Sophie / Marcus

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned: 

Call summary: 
- Use case: FinPay wants to reduce authorization latency for high-volume checkout flows and centralize model serving for fraud scoring and conversational receipts. 
- Primary success criteria: 25% reduction in p99 latency and 20% cost-per-transaction savings vs current setup.
- Timeline: pilot in Q3, production by end of Q4 if procurement + security sign off.

Stakeholder map (as we understand it):
- Economic buyer: Marcus Green (Head of Payments) — signs budget.
- Technical champion: Sophie Liang (Lead Platform Eng) — owns eval + integration.
- Security/regulatory: Anita Rao (Procurement/Security liaison) — will run security/compliance and procurement steps.

Next steps / MAP (proposed milestones):
1) Redwood sends MAP draft + security questionnaire (this email) — action: Redwood (Marissa / Camila) — target: 2026-07-15
2) FinPay to share procurement checklist + any required SSO/KMS details — action: Anita/Marcus — target: 2026-07-22
3) Pilot scope & success metrics doc — action: Sophie + Redwood — target: 2026-07-29
4) Procurement & security review complete — action: FinPay Legal & Security — target: 2026-08-12
5) Pilot kickoff — action: Redwood & FinPay Eng — target: 2026-08-19

Attachments: I attached a first-pass MAP draft and our security QA spreadsheet — you can use these to share with procurement/security.

Can you confirm the stakeholder list above and the timing? If those targets look reasonable I'll drop a formal MAP in Drive and update HubSpot.

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and accurate. A couple of quick clarifications: 

- Economic buyer is Marcus as you noted. He prefers to do budget decisions in the last week of July, so hitting procurement by 7/22 would be great.
- Procurement/security contact is Anita Rao (CC'd) — she'll own the security questionnaire and procurement checklist.
- For the pilot scope, I'll own the integration plan but I'll need Camila's help on sample traffic and expected seq lengths to build a realistic latency baseline.
